description: [Experimental / Unofficial] A VS Code research and report-writing extension for OpenCode, designed to run alongside the OpenCode TUI. This extension is developed primarily through AI-assisted coding and provided as-is without warranty. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the OpenCode project.
configuration.nonoProfile: Optional workspace-scoped custom nono profile override for Chat; enabled sandboxing uses the validated built-in opencode profile by default, and Scribe stores only an explicit name.
